consent.title: Cookies and analytics
consent.body: We only use what Vinko needs to work. Analytics stays off until you accept it: it helps us improve the app and never includes your name or email.
ajustes.title: Settings
ajustes.langHint: During the alpha the app is shown in Spanish. We save your preference for when more languages go live.
ajustes.error: Could not save. Please try again.
ajustes.analyticsHint: Anonymous usage statistics to improve Vinko. Never your name or email. You can change it any time.
ajustes.exportHint: A JSON file with your profile, picks, porras, comments and notifications.
ajustes.deleteHint: Your personal data is removed: username, avatar, birth year, notifications, groups and subscriptions. Your picks stay anonymous so the porras you joined keep working. Your Vinkos are lost.
ajustes.deleteError: The account could not be deleted. Try again or write to us.
